brief: @buildthis.bisks.net create an interactive page that helps users develop better intuition around various forms of statistical bias, like survivorship bias. It should be a solid, informative reference for a 3rd grader.
note: built Bias Detective Academy: 6 kid-friendly cases (survivorship, selection, confirmation, availability, hindsight, small-sample bias), badges, a certificate, and a field guide for quick reference.
